dimensions.assessment: Affects regional entities, water systems, and local populations in South Dakota reliant on municipal, rural, and industrial water planning.
dimensions.evidence: Western Dakota Regional Water System, Inc., a nonprofit corporation

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes a study and reporting requirement to determine project feasibility and cost-sharing structures, without immediately authorizing project construction.
dimensions.evidence: carry out a study to determine the feasibility of the Western South Dakota Water Supply Project

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes up to $10,000,000 in federal funds for the study, with a federal share not exceeding 50 percent.
dimensions.evidence: Not more than $10,000,000 of Federal funds may be expended to carry out the feasibility study

dimensions.assessment: Directs a specific administrative and engineering study with reporting requirements to congressional committees.
dimensions.evidence: develop a feasibility report that includes a recommendation of the Secretary

dimensions.assessment: Temporary authority that expires 5 years after the date of enactment.
dimensions.evidence: expires on the date that is 5 years after the date of enactment of this Act

missing_information: Total estimated cost of the full water supply project if eventually constructed.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill requires the Secretary of the Interior to conduct a feasibility study, capped at $10,000,000 in federal funds, regarding the Western South Dakota Water Supply Project over a period of up to 5 years.
